description: FlowNodeSet stores the discovered flow nodes for a NetworkFlowDiscovery resource.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: FlowNodeSetSpec defines the desired state of FlowNodeSet.

discoveryRef.description: discoveryRef is the name of the parent NetworkFlowDiscovery resource

status.description: FlowNodeSetStatus defines the observed state of FlowNodeSet.

nodes.description: nodes are all discovered services, databases, crons, and external endpoints

items.description: FlowNode represents a service, database, cron job, or external endpoint.

group.description: group is the logical group (namespace name by default)

id.description: id is the unique node identifier (e.g. "service:core:my-account-api")

nodeType.description: nodeType is one of: service, cron, database, messaging, external
